advisor_identified: Andrew C. (Andrew Colin) Gow, professor of history at the University of Alberta.

doctorate.title: The Red Jews: Apocalypticism and Antisemitism in Medieval and Early Modern Germany

evidence.says: The 2018–2019 staff calendar, PDF page 12, lists Andrew C. Gow as professor in History and Classics with a PhD from the University of Arizona, 1993.
Arizona’s Division for Late Medieval and Reformation Studies newsletter (November 2009), page 8, lists alumnus Andrew C. Gow, PhD 1993, at the University of Alberta, Edmonton.
The publisher’s author information identifies Andrew C. Gow as professor of history at Alberta and states that he earned his PhD at Arizona in 1993.

The search-indexed dissertation title page names Andrew Colin Gow, the Department of History, University of Arizona, Doctor of Philosophy, 1993, and gives the title The Red Jews: Apocalypticism and Antisemitism in Medieval and Early Modern Germany.

notes: The linked record matches the advisor’s name, institution, department, year and dissertation subject. Its title ends with “Europe”; the repository title page says “Germany.” This title discrepancy does not indicate a namesake. The repository PDF was available through its indexed title-page text; direct retrieval returned HTTP 403.
